# Vendored dependency

`p5.min.js` is the project's existing **p5.js 1.6.0**, hosted locally so the studio works offline without a CDN request.

Source: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/p5@1.6.0/lib/p5.min.js
License: LGPL-2.1, included in `p5.LICENSE.txt`.

Geist is hosted locally in `assets/fonts/`, with its SIL Open Font License in `Geist-LICENSE.txt`. It is used for the wordmark and headings; controls use the system monospace font.
